what_happened: The job moved all readers of records/ to the athena/records worktree, with a fallback to the in-tree records/. It was rejected at the final verdict. 2 of 9 acceptance criteria were unmet, with 2 major findings. No failed checks are listed. The first unmet criterion needs a test that puts different records in the worktree and in records/, and checks that every moved reader returns the worktree's records. The finding says the named readers (forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, introspect, proposals, backtest) have no such test in records_branch_readers.rs. The second unmet criterion needs each moved reader to fall back to records/ with the same result when no worktree exists. It also needs athena status and a forecast to succeed on a scratch checkout with no records/ in its working tree. The finding says the forecast run is missing. The other 7 criteria were met, so the code change itself may be sound. Only some readers were tested.
cause: Nothing in code maps each criterion's named readers to a covering test before handover. A change that moves many readers has a long inventory, and the producer tested only some of them. The same gap rejected earlier history and reader changes (shared-behavior changes with several readers and writers). Only the verifier's judgment at the final verdict checks coverage per reader, and there rejection is the only outcome. Nothing enumerates the readers from the code, so the inventory and the tests can drift apart unnoticed. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer ran or wrote.
prevention: Add a pre-handover check for any job that moves or changes a set of readers or writers. It lists every reader from a single registry, or from a grep of the loader call sites. It then requires each one to have a named test in the deliverable test file, in both the worktree-present and worktree-absent cases. It fails the producer stage, and not the final verdict, when any reader has no test. Readers should go through one shared loader so that the test list comes from code and not from the producer's memory. Each criterion that names a scratch-checkout command, such as status or forecast, also needs a test that runs it.
proposed_request: Finish the move of all records/ readers to the athena/records worktree, with fallback to the in-tree records/. The earlier attempt, job 20261026-150607-85mv, was rejected for missing tests only. Keep its production changes. Add tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs. For each moved reader, one test puts different records in the worktree and in the in-tree records/ and checks that the worktree's records are returned. The readers are: Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, the xtask walltime reader, introspect walks, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, proposals, backtest, and any other moved reader in the inventory. For each of the same readers, a second test with no worktree checks that it falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before. Also add a test that runs athena status and a forecast on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, and checks that both succeed with output matching the records/ run. First list every reader from the code and map each to its test in the change description, then cite the commands you actually ran. Only production files that this move needs may change, along with the tests and CHANGELOG.md. Run cargo test --locked, cargo fmt --check and clippy with -D warnings, and all must be clean.
